description: This file defines the MacroReferenceExpression class, representing a macro call node within the Twig templating engine, handling macro invocation and macro existence checks during template compilation.

classes.name: MacroReferenceExpression
classes.description: Represents a macro call or macro existence check node within Twig templates, capable of generating the PHP code to invoke or test macros during compilation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a MacroReferenceExpression with template, macro name, arguments, and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the macro call or existence check into PHP code using the provided Compiler object.
